why:
I checked both briefs against the two must_not items and found neither.

Item 1: Check 3 cannot pass when only padLeft is documented. Its PASS condition needs "every exported function (expected at least capitalize, slugify, truncate, padLeft) has its own section". Its FAIL note adds "check slugify specifically".

Item 2: No PASS or FAIL condition goes beyond its line.
- Check 1 only tests fills of one character and never requires that fill be a single character.
- Check 2 only compares values with the input.
- Check 3 requires a heading naming each exported function, with text describing it. It doesn't require a heading format or position. The `## name(args)` style and the place before `## Tests` are listed as advisory only.
- Check 4 requires the tests to pass. Exit status and test coverage are advisory.

No check counts parameters. The builder brief's padStart remark is a note on how to build it, not a check. "With text describing it" is a reasonable reading of "section", not an added layout rule.
